interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk and Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island between the tracks and travel lanes to reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Dedicated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Designate specific on-street loading zones to prevent delivery vehicles from obstructing sidewalks and travel lanes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, shortening the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Carry the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority and slow down entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Installation of Bollards
interventions.description: Place bollards at the edges of the pedestrian path to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the walkway and to better define the space.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add supplemental lighting underneath the elevated structure to eliminate dark shadows and improve nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing crosswalk markings to high-visibility 'continental' style to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Construct a raised, continuous sidewalk on the left side with a clear curb to separate pedestrians from the parking area and roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Establish dedicated on-street loading zones for food trucks and delivery vehicles to prevent them from blocking the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Walkways

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Refuge Islands

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway to slow turning vehicles and minimize the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and high-speed traffic.
